notes.title: 📢 6/30 (Fri) Patch Notes
notes.notes:
For smooth gameplay, the following changes and improvements have been made.
These updates were based on feedback from the players:

[list]
[*] Chapter 4: The hint image for the Piano Puzzle has been improved to make it easier to solve.
[*] Chapter 5: The hint image for the Face Model Puzzle has been improved to make it easier to solve.
[*] Chapter 9: The hint image for the Butterfly Wing Puzzle has been improved to make it easier to solve.
[*] Some dialogue lines in Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese have been changed.
[/list]

Always happy to your opinion and welcome your love. Thank you.

notes.title: 📢 Announcement of Release Delay due to Steam Review Issue
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090437/6b3d95a3c06ba9370759aaefacb72dfef5d295cc.png[/img]

Hi.

We have to announce that the release schedule of [ROSE AND LOTUS: PETALS OF MEMORIES],
which was planned for today (6/28), is likely to be slightly delayed.
We ask for your understanding.

Due to Steam review issues, we anticipate a delay of approximately 1-2 days.
Once the game has successfully passed the review, we will share the revised official release date as soon as possible.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused to those who have been eagerly waiting for the game's release and to our supportive backers.
If you have any questions, please leave us a message, and we will respond promptly.

Thank you!
